title: Suspension of Delay Fines During Sudden Incident Conditions
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Delay fine is applicable in principle
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a delay fine (غرامة التأخير) is imposed on the contractor who delays in fulfilling his obligations as a general principle. FAIL if the note does not state that a delay fine is imposed on the contractor who delays in fulfilling his obligations as a general principle.

criteria.title: Sudden incident suspends obligation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a sudden incident (حادث فجائي) does not fully exempt the contractor from the obligation but rather suspends its execution until the incident ceases. FAIL if the note does not state that a sudden incident suspends execution of the obligation without fully exempting the contractor from it.

criteria.title: No fine during suspension period
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a delay fine is not imposed for the period of suspension resulting from a sudden incident. FAIL if the note does not state that a delay fine is not imposed for the period of suspension resulting from a sudden incident.

criteria.title: Fatwa department opinion required
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that exemption from the fine for the suspension period is conditional on obtaining the opinion of the competent Fatwa Department (إدارة الفتوى) at the State Council. FAIL if the note does not state that exemption from the fine for the suspension period is conditional on obtaining the opinion of the competent Fatwa Department at the State Council.

criteria.title: Conditions of sudden incident
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a sudden incident must be both unforeseeable and impossible to repel. FAIL if the note does not state that a sudden incident must be both unforeseeable and impossible to repel.
